recommendation.qualification: Not an absolute per-frame floor: frame p99 reached 41.8–49.9 ms in two 35 percent runs. Host load and camera contents vary.

method: One heavy browser tab and the same frozen build. Centered views at 20/25/30/35/40 percent, five-second warmup and 25 seconds per sample. Two 35 percent centered runs plus a right-side pan before warmup completed. Production and physical cargo stay active across all 2,400 nodes. No heavy build/test tools ran during timing windows.
